verdict.rationale: New Relic's official CLI records APM deployment markers (gh-2, docs-38), which covers the release-tracking half of the story. The evidence never shows how those markers are overlaid on performance charts to correlate regressions, and it does not mention tracking configuration changes. Missing for 10: tracking of configuration or other non-deploy changes, documented correlation of deploy markers with regressions in charts or analysis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
